description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainIpaConnData operation to query the number of connections for IP Application Accelerator (IPA)
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-ipa-conn-data --domain-name example1.com --start-time 2015-02-21T07:00:00Z --end-time 2015-02-22T7:00:00Z --split-by domain --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnDomainIpaConnData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name for the IPA application. To specify multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,).

If you leave this parameter empty, the merged data for all accelerated domain names is returned
parameters.help_zh:
IPA层应用加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。
若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名合并后数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The method to group the data. Valid values:

domain: The data is grouped by accelerated domain name.

If you leave this parameter empty, the data is not grouped. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果分组方式。取值：

domain：按加速域名分组。

参数为空（默认）：查询结果不分组
parameters.name: split_by

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range that was queried

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range that was queried
